1/ Cash Flow Brief, Nov 12 ☀️

US envoys head to Moscow, inflation ran hotter than expected, and Bitcoin is down this week.

What happened, why it matters, and what could happen next 🧵

2/ Politics: Kushner and Witkoff head to Moscow to meet Putin after Abu Dhabi Ukraine talks ended without a breakthrough.

Why it matters: Energy prices and sanctions could move.

Next: If a deal emerges, oil may ease; if not, risk stays high.

3/ Economy: US inflation beat expectations and Treasury yields rose.

Why it matters: Higher yields can push up mortgage and loan rates.

Next: Jobless claims at 8:30 AM New York time (forecast 194K). If they top it, watch the job market.

4/ Stocks: Nvidia fell 5.5% on Nov. 10 after an unverified report tied CEO Jensen Huang to a Chinese intelligence asset.

Why it matters: Nvidia is a large part of many index funds.

Next: If the FBI probe grows, AI stocks may stay under pressure.

5/ Crypto: Bitcoin is $73,287, down 8.4% over 7 days, and Fear and Greed reads 28.

Why it matters: ETF outflows show weak demand, and the CLARITY Act is stalled.

Next: If outflows continue, watch whether BTC keeps sliding.

Not financial advice.
